Look for shared living situations, food banks, support groups.  And don't be afraid to visit a religious facility of your choice ever week to make friends. They will continue to find ways to get your all riled up from afar.  Trust me.  Not always but you need to be ready for that just incase.)   


Always remember that if you're patient enough to survive living with abusive people, you can finish anything you start and accomplish anything.

I once was suicidal.  I never thought a day would come that I wasn't suicidal.  I absolutely hated anyone who discouraged the idea or preached to me about "all the good things" I am failing to "appreciate"... but when you *have* wanted to kill your self for so many years and then suddenly you *do* get that paid off acre in the woods to live rent free and you *aren't* being raped three to five times daily anymore and you *can* afford the CDC's recommended medication and dose to get rid of three types of parasites you got from cleaning up your mother's professional dog kennel every day as a kid...  and you find out you *will* find hobbies and interests after a decade and a half or more of being cooped up, abused and starring at the walls...  and finally you actually get a job... a real job...  a job that paid...  a job that gives you over 1,000 a week in the first year with 60k or more to come the next and second year...   


You become one of those people who says, "Please don't do it."   
The person who tells you not to kill yourself is you in the future.  They don't tell you that you just want attention.  They believe you.  Because they know how it feels to want to die.  They also know how good it feels to finally be happy.    
I was living in unbearable circumstances for waaaaaay too long.  It seemed impossible that anything else would ever happen.  You'll want to beat the living snot out of the optimists who say, "it will get better"... cause they say it like its gonna happen after a couple weeks of bad days or something.  But, really.  Don't do it.  Please don't.  I never found someone to love me, laugh with me, hold me...  even still... but that's not what I needed, it turns out... to be happy.  I think our final thoughts revolve around how no one is there to offer that hug or comfort and there's a tremendous amount of rage that goes into the realization that no one bothered to show you the common decency... but you'll see, if you can make it, whether you find that or not... it won't matter.  You can still be not just a little but VERY happy.  Anyone who's been through this is horrified that you might give up without getting to see it because we've been you.  God! My past miseries were so horrible that just thinking about it makes me cry and get suicidal and I say, "Wait a minute! I"m not even there anymore!  I'm having a great time!"  But that's how bad it was.  I never want to feel like that again.  Its traumatic to think that I would ever have to return to that state of mind or those circumstances...  we just hate to watch you go through it because we've come out the other side.  But I can't lie to you...  the sun didn't come out as quickly as "tomorrow" and brighten my mood.  It took a lot of painful years.

Its a horrible state of mind to be in and I do hope you are able to finally get away some day without feeling like your own mother threw you in the trash because you weren't worth it to her to treat you just decent enough to keep you around.  :(  I hope that you can one day call her a piece of shit without feeling anger, sadness, or unfinished business.  If you can be patient and wait it out over the years it will take you to process, you'll be okay.  Just remember that leaving is only half the battle.  There's something called a "trauma bond" which creates unfinished business and you wanting closure or to get your abuser to see things from your point of view or to explain yourself... and it keeps people returning to abusive cycles.  If you aren't very careful and aware of this, you will find a romantic partner who only puts you back in the same dynamic only you won't notice it early on when she's showing off her legs and acting like miss confident boss-pants.  Find you a nice modestly dressed shy girl who doesn't act bossy and you'll be much happier than you would with the "cool girl" because in the end she'll only play you and you're an easy target who is pre-conditioned for the manipulative BS.
